source: 560 Traces
target: 560 Vestigia

source: Lato rarely divulged details about the sea prayer ritual.
target: Lato vix enarrare solebat singula de ritu orationis maris.

source: He spoke with a weighty demeanor, “Yes, the Governor of the Sea ties the knot with the sea, quelling its violence and bringing peace.
target: Gravitate loquebatur Lato: “Ita vero, Praefectus Maris nodum cum mari iungit, eius vim reprimens atque pacem afferens.

source: They truly become the spouse of the sea, commanding authority over this stretch of water.
target: Revera fit maris maritus, super hac aquarum parte imperium praedicans.

source: “As the assistant and deputy hosts, we also gain varying degrees of in Port Santa receive some boons, although they are limited in number.”
target: “Ut adiutores et vice hospites, etiam in Portu Santa aliquas benefactiones variis modis accipimus, quamvis numerus eorum limitatus sit.”

source: So, the Governor of the Sea is synonymous with Husband of the Sea.
target: Itaque Praefectus Maris idem valet ac Vir Maris.

source: The assistant and deputy hosts are like close friends or family busy assisting at a wedding, naturally earning gratitude.
target: Adiutores et vice hospites sunt quasi amici intimi vel cognati, nuptiis auxilio occupantes, unde naturaliter gratiam consequantur.

source: Those with the sea bloodline are akin to children attending a wedding, typically gaining some candy…
target: Qui sanguine marino insiti sunt, similes pueris nuptiarum adstant, plerumque aliquod dulcedinem adepti…

source: Lumian attempted to comprehend Lato Guiaro’s description of the sea prayer ritual by combining reality and wedding traditions in novels.
target: Lumian conatus est intellegere enarrationem Lati Guiaro de ritu orationis maris, realitatem et nuptiarum traditiones in fabulis coniungendo.

source: Intrigued, he inquired, “Does the Governor of the Sea engage in those acts with the sea?”
target: Cautus interrogavit: “Num Praefectus Maris istis actibus cum mari se implicat?”

source: Aren’t weddings supposed to conclude with newlyweds consummating their marriage?
target: Nonne nuptiae finem habere debent cum nuptis matrimonium consummant?

source: “Of course!” Lato affirmed, “After the wedding, the sea will bind itself to the four Maidens of the Sea.
target: “Certe!” Lato asseruit, “Post nuptias, mare se ligabit ad quattuor Virgines Maris.

source: Through their union with the Governor of the Sea, the first child of each Maiden of the Sea is a noble with a pure sea bloodline, possessing the strongest Beyonder powers.
target: Per coniunctionem cum Praefecto Maris, primogenitus cuiusque Virgines Maris erit nobilis cum puro sanguine marino, potentissimas vires Beyonder habens.

source: “Why four and not one Maiden of the Sea? It’s because individual humans can’t endure the vastness, expansiveness, weight, and transcendence of the sea. Enough partners are needed to share the burden.”
target: “Cur quattuor et non una Virgo Maris? Quia singuli homines immensitatem, extensionem, pondus, atque sublimitatem maris tolerare non possunt; plures socii necessarii sunt ut onus dividatur.”

source: The more I listen, the more ominous it becomes…
target: Quo magis ausculto, eo minacius videtur…

source: Marrying a Maiden of the Sea is akin to marrying a remnant of the sea’s power.
target: Nuptio Virgini Maris similis est matrimonium reliquiae potentiae maris.

source: It’s no wonder they’re highly valued, and their destinies change.
target: Non mirum est eos magni aestimari atque fata eorum mutari.

source: The only challenge is acknowledging and loving their wife’s first child.
target: Unicum impedimentum est primogenitum uxoris agnoscere atque diligere.

source: Lumian contemplated for a moment and remarked, “And the Governor of the Sea can withstand the passion of the sea?”
target: Lumian paulisper meditatus est et dixit: “Atque Praefectus Maris potestne passionem maris ferre?”

source: And it was four at a time.
target: Et quattuor simul erant.

source: Lato, devoid of pity or sympathy, stated, “One of the two most crucial purposes of the vigil ritual is to utilize the house and some of the sea spawn concealed within it to transform the Governor of the Sea’s body, enabling them to withstand the violent and unrestrained sea.
target: Lato, carens misericordia aut compassione, dixerat: “Una ex duobus propositis maxime essentialibus ritu vigiliae est ut domum et aliqua semina maris, quae intus latent, adhibeat ad corpus Praefecti Maris transformandum, ita ut violentum et immoderatum mare ferre valeat.”

source: “That’s why the Governor of the Sea can only serve for a year. Even with the physical transformation, the power acquisition, and the Beyonder enhancement, they won’t endure much longer.”
target: “Ideo Praefectus Maris solum unius anni fungitur. Etiam cum transformatione corporali, acquisitione potentiae, atque incremento Beyonder, diutius non perferet.”

source: Consumable. The husband of the sea is a consumable…
target: Consumibilis. Vir Maris consumibilis est…

source: Lumian sighed inwardly and queried, “Then why would the Governor of the Sea return to the sea after leaving office?”
target: Lumian intus sufflavit et interrogavit: “Cur igitur Praefectus Maris, postquam officia relinquit, ad mare revertatur?”

source: “No one knows the exact reason, but there’s a certain conjecture.
target: “Nemo causam certam novit, sed quaedam coniectura est.

source: Juan Oro believes that the sea doesn’t allow those who were once its husband to start a new life.
target: Juan Oro credit mare non sinere eos, qui olim maritus Maris fuerunt, vitam novam inchoare.

source: And I believe that the modifications of the vigil ritual, the intrusion of spousal intercourse, and the influence of maritime authority make the Governor of the Sea more and more like a sea creature and less human.
target: Et ego credo mutationes ritu vigiliae, intrusiones congressus coniugalis, atque imperium maritimum Praefectum Maris magis magisque ad creaturam maris similem et minus humanum reddere.

source: Eventually, he will inevitably return to the sea that gives him peace and comfort.”
target: Postremo, inevitabiliter ad mare, quod ei pacem atque solatium affert, revertetur.”

source: Lato felt that his deduction was correct.
target: Lato sensit deductionem suam esse rectam.

source: What exactly is the sea you’re referring to?
target: Quidnam est mare, ad quod referis?

source: Is it a natural spirit or a creature beyond, controlling the sea?
target: Estne numen naturale aut creatura extra, quae mare regit?

source: Lumian replayed Lato Guiaro’s answers in his mind before asking, “Sea spawn? Like the wrinkled monsters that can disguise themselves as devils, and the long black insects that control humans by burrowing into their necks?”
target: Lumian in mente responsa Lato Guiaro recoluit, antequam rogavit: “Semina maris? Sicut monstra rugosa, quae se habere possunt ut daemones, et insecta nigra longa, quae homines regunt, se fodientes in cervicibus eorum?”

source: “Yes,” Lato responded, yearning for a cigarette but unable to move his hands.
target: “Ita,” respondit Lato, desiderans cigarettam, sed manibus movere non potens.

source: “We, the Children of the Sea, are spawn of the sea.
target: “Nos, Filii Maris, sumus semen maris.

source: One of our duties is guiding certain sea spawn from the depths to settle on land using our Beyonder powers, helping them reproduce.”
target: Una ex officiis nostris est ducendo quaedam semina maris e profundis ad terram consederi, viribus Beyonder adhibendis, ut ea multiplicentur.

source: However, Ludwig mentioned that the Batings Black Insects originate from another planet, not some sea spawn…
target: Tamen, Ludwig annotavit insecta Nigra Batings ex alio planeta originaria esse, non ex aliquo semine maris…

source: Lumian didn’t rush to ask about the Children of the Sea’s Beyonder powers; instead, he focused on the details of the sea prayer ritual.
target: Lumian non festinavit rogare de viribus Beyonder Filii Maris; sed potius in singulis minutis ritu orationis maris intendit.

source: “What’s the other vital purpose of the vigil?”
target: “Quid est alterum propositum vitale ritu vigiliae?”

source: Lato’s expression hinted: “Don’t you understand what weddings are about?”
target: Vultus Lato insinuavit: “Nonne intellegis quid nuptiae sint?”

source: “Well, there’s the exchange of rings for marriage.
target: “Bene, adsunt commercium annulorum pro nuptiis.

source: And the vigil ritual modifies the Governor of the Sea’s body, attaching a unique trait to a fixed golden ring, matching it to the sea bride’s identity.”
target: Et ritu vigiliae corpus Praefecti Maris mutatur, ad annulum aureum fixum proprietate unicam adnexus, qui congruens fiat cum identitate sponsae Maris.

source: A unique golden ring… Lumian perked up and said, “And then?”
target: Annulus aureus unicus… Lumian excitatus dixit: “Et deinde?”

source: During last year’s April Fool’s prank, fringe members received orders to acquire a gold ring from Torres and conceal it within the lamb sacrifice’s stomach!
target: Per iocum Aprilis Stultorum anni praeteriti, membra marginaria mandata acceperunt ut annulum aureum a Torres adipirent et eum intra ventrem agni sacrificii celarent!

source: “Then, following the completion of the other rituals, the Governor of the Sea will take the golden ring and cast it directly into the sea before the ship.
target: “Deinde, post cetera ritu perfuncta, Praefectus Maris annulum aureum recipiet et eum directe in mare ante navem iaciet.

source: He will utter in a unique language from the depths,
target: Eloquent in lingua singulari e profundis,

source: ‘We espouse thee, O sea, as a sign of true and perpetual dominion!’”
target: ‘Te sponsamus, o mare, ut signum verae atque perpetuae dominationis!’”

source: “If the sea consents to this union, gentle waves will stir, transforming into pure white foam petals that will shower over the four Maidens of the Sea.
target: “Si mare huic coniunctioni consentierit, leves fluctus agitabuntur, qui in petala candida spumosa pura transformabuntur et super quattuor Virgines Maris effunderentur.

source: “The returned ring carries symbolic weight, signifying authority over the waters surrounding Port Santa[1].”
target: “Annulus reditus pondus symbolicum fert, significans auctoritatem super aquas circum Portum Santa[1].”

source: Just the waters encompassing Port Santa? From the indications, it seems it’s not the true sea, but rather something that affects this specific area of the waters…
target: Solum aquae, quae Portum Santa circumstant, videtur? Ex indiciis videtur non esse verum mare, sed aliquid quod hanc specificam partem aquarum afficit…

source: Lumian paused briefly before speaking, “How do you express ‘We espouse thee, O sea…’ in that peculiar language?”
target: Lumian brevi momento cessavit antequam loqui inciperet: “Quomodo dicitur ‘Te sponsamus, o mare…’ in illa lingua insolita?”

source: Lato Guiaro contemplated for a moment before emitting a chattering sound.
target: Lato Guiaro paulisper meditatus est, deinde sonum stridulentem edidit.

source: Under the influence of the Language Comprehension charms, Lumian failed to grasp its meaning.
target: Sub incantationum intellegentiae linguae impulsu, Lumian eius significationem capere non potuit.

source: He concluded it wasn’t part of the Northern Continent’s languages.
target: Concluxit eam non esse partem linguarum Continenti Septentrionalis.

source: Simultaneously, he observed the Knight of Swords in Lato’s eyes slightly shaking his head.
target: Simul observavit Equestrem Gladii in oculis Lato, qui leviter caput concutiebat.

source: If the Knight of Swords truly belongs to the temperance faction that parted ways from the Rose School of Thought to align with the Church of The Fool, he should possess knowledge of the Southern Continent’s language.
target: Si Eques Gladii vere ad factionem temperantiae pertineat, quae se a Schola Rosi Opinionum separatam congregavit ut Ecclesiae Stulti consocietur, debet scientiam linguae Continenti Meridionalis habere.

source: Additionally, with his high Sequence and extensive tenure as a Beyonder, he must have encountered most supernatural tongues.
target: Praeterea, cum altis gradibus et longis annis ut Beyonder functus sit, debet plerasque linguas supernaturales expertus esse.

source: Does this imply it’s not from the language family of the Southern Continent, let alone ancient Hermes, Dragonese, Elvish, or other mystical languages?
target: Num hoc implicat non esse eam ex familia linguarum Continenti Meridionalis, nedum ex sermone antiquo Hermes, Dragonese, Elvish aut aliis linguis mysticis?

source: Lumian regarded Lato Guiaro with an intrigued grin.
target: Lumian Lato Guiaro intuens cum risu curiose delectato spectabat.

source: “Are you certain those words translate to ‘We espouse thee, O sea…’?”
target: “Certus es haec verba vertere in ‘Te sponsamus, o mare…’?”

source: Lato hesitated briefly before explaining, “Probably. This is a language passed down from ancient times, existing since the sea prayer ritual. There are only a few sentences…”
target: Lato paulisper dubitavit antequam explicavit: “Fortasse. Haec lingua ex antiquis temporibus tradita est, exstans ab initio ritu orationis maris. Sententiae paucae tantum sunt…”

source: He’s not sure… They hadn’t systematically mastered the language, only capable of uttering two or three sentences based on the legacy… Lumian sensed there might be more to it than Lato’s description; there was no denial if the true meaning was akin to “Open Sesame.”
target: Non est certus… Illi linguam non per systema didicerunt, sed tantum duas vel tres sententias ex tradita hereditate profecerunt; Lumian sensit plura esse posse quam Lato enarravit, neque refutabantur, si verus sensus similis “Aperi Sesamum” fuisset.

source: The folks from the Fisheries Guild and Milo Village might have been akin to the individuals Aurore and Franca spoke of.
target: Populi ex Gremio Piscariorum et Milo Vicus fortasse similes erant illis personis de quibus Aurore et Franca locuti sunt.

source: They employed a peculiar language, its true meaning eluding them as they substituted it with their own interpretation.
target: Linguam peculiare utebantur, cuius verus significatus eis evaniebat, dum suam interpretationem adhibebant.

source: As Lumian pondered, his expression remained unchanged.
target: Dum Lumian meditabatur, vultus eius immutatus remansit.

source: “Does the Governor of the Sea safeguard the ring after he acquires the special trait?”
target: “Num Praefectus Maris annulum custodit postquam proprietatem specialem adipiscit?”

source: “No,” Lato responded, shaking his head.
target: “Non,” respondit Lato, caput concutiens.

source: “In addition to the Governor of the Sea, the Maidens of the Sea, and sailors in charge of controlling the ship, there are four pure-blooded Children of the Sea acting as deputy hosts.
target: “Praeter Praefectum Maris, Virgines Maris, et nautas gubernantes, quatuor sunt Filii Maris ex pura stirpe, qui ut vice hospites funguntur.

source: They guide the Governor and the Maidens through the ritual stages, teaching the unique call to marriage.
target: Illi Praefectum atque Virgines per gradus ritu ducunt, et unicam vocem ad matrimonium docent.

source: The golden ring is held by one of the deputy hosts and only handed over to the Governor when needed.
target: Annulus aureus ab uno ex hospitibus vicariis tenetur, atque solum Praefecto Maris traditur, cum necessitatibus oriri videntur.

source: The Governor of the Sea doesn’t have a chance to switch ritual rings…
target: Praefectus Maris occasionem non habet ut annulos rituos mutet…

source: Suppressing his anxiety, Lumian continued at a measured pace, “Did the sea prayer ritual fail last year?”
target: Anxietatem reprimens, Lumian modeste pergebat: “Num ritu orationis maris anno praeterito defecit?”

source: Lato initially seemed taken aback, but then relief crossed his face.
target: Lato primo stupefactus apparuit, sed deinde levamen vultum suum ostendit.

source: “Did the imposter seek your help?”
target: “Num impostor auxilium tuum quaesivit?”

source: “Yes, for some reason, the sea prayer ritual failed.
target: “Ita, quaedam ratione, ritu orationis maris defecit.

source: The sea’s rage claimed the lives of the Governor of the Sea and the four Children of the Sea serving as deputy hosts.
target: Ira maris vitas Praefecti Maris atque quattuor Filii Maris, qui ut hospites vicarii agebant, subtraxit.

source: Only the Maidens of the Sea and some sailors survived.
target: Solum Virgines Maris et quidam nautae supervixerunt.

source: The four deputy hosts are dead? Just as Lumian uncovered clues about April Fool’s, he sensed the link had been abruptly severed.
target: Quatuor hospitibus vicariis mortui sunt? Eodem tempore, dum Lumian vestigia de ioco Aprilis Stultorum deprehendit, sensit nexum subito disrumpi.

source: The individuals with the best chance of substituting the ceremonial ring had all perished in the unsuccessful sea prayer ritual!
target: Qui optimam facultatem habebant annulum caerimonialem substituendi, omnes in ritu orationis maris inepto perierunt!

source: Lumian thought for a moment before inquiring, “What happened to the surviving Maidens of the Sea and sailors?”
target: Lumian paulisper meditatus est, deinde rogavit: “Quid accidit superviventibus Virginibus Maris et nautis?”

source: “They’re still alive, but under strict surveillance.”
target: “Adhuc sunt in vita, sed sub rigida vigilantia.”

source: Realizing that the failure to last year’s sea prayer ritual was exposed, Lato, not dwelling on the survivors’ details, continued, “We arranged marriages for the four Maidens of the Sea who lack actual sea powers with ordinary family members.
target: Intellexit defectum ritu orationis maris anni praeteriti patefactum esse; Lato, de superviventium singularitatibus non demorans, continuavit: “Nuptias ordinavimus pro quattuor Virgines Maris, quarum vera potentia marina caret, cum membris familiaribus ordinariis.

source: Though it won’t bring about a Beyonder-level change, it has its benefits.
target: Quamquam mutationem ad gradum Beyonder non afferet, tamen sua beneficia praebet.

source: “The sailors, from Milo Village, received some benefits from Juan Oro but are restricted from leaving Milo Village until this year’s sea prayer ritual succeeds.”
target: “Nauta, ex Milo Vicus, aliqua beneficia a Juan Oro receperunt, sed exire ex Milo Vicus prohibiti sunt, donec ritu orationis maris huius anni succedat.”

source: Shifting gears, Lumian asked, “Did the sailors transport the sacrificial lambs and other offerings for the marriage to the sea to the deck?”
target: Mutans rimam, Lumian rogavit: “Num nautae agnos sacrificatorios et alia munera pro nuptiis cum mari in tabulam navis transporterunt?”

source: “Yes.” Lato nodded.
target: “Ita.” Lato annuit.

source: “Sailors handle such cumbersome and laborious tasks.”
target: “Nautae talia onera gravia et laboriosa gerunt.”

source: Within the ranks of sailors, one among Bard, Mad Lady, or Ultraman had sneaked in.
target: Inter nautas, unus, sive Bard sive Mad Lady sive Ultraman, late insinuatus est.

source: If the other side held a stronger Beyonder power or a mystical item from the Marauder pathway, they could snatch the genuine ceremonial ring during the exchange, swapping it with a counterfeit…
target: Si altera pars potentiam Beyonder robustiorem aut rem mysticam ex via Marauder haberet, genuinum annulum caerimonialem tempore commercii rapere poterant, eum autem falso commutantes…

source: It wouldn’t be a surprise that the Marauder pathway, influenced by the Celestial Worthy, has key April Fool’s members wielding matching strengths or artifacts…
target: Non mirum est, cum via Marauder, sub incitamento a Celestial Worthy, principales membri Aprilis Stultorum vim aut artificia congrua gerant…

source: Lumian swiftly suspected this.
target: Lumian celeriter hoc suspicatus est.

source: He turned to Lato Guiaro, keeping his tone composed.
target: Se convertit ad Lato Guiaro, tonum suum placidum servans.

source: “Tell me about the four Maidens of the Sea and the survivors from last year among the sailors.”
target: “Narra mihi de quattuor Virgines Maris et de superviventibus ex anno praeterito inter nautas.”

source: Lato recounted the details from memory.
target: Lato ex memoria enarravit singula.

source: Having absorbed the specifics about the potential targets, Lumian inquired further, “Were all participants in the sea sacrificial part thoroughly checked?”
target: Postquam singularia de scopis potentialibus comprehensit, Lumian rogavit: “Num omnes participes in parte sacrificii maris diligenter examinati sunt?”

source: “Absolutely. No unauthorized items allowed onboard to maintain the ritual’s integrity.
target: “Absolute. Nullae res non licitae admittuntur in nave ut integritas ritu servetur.

source: And before the ship reaches its destination, Juan Oro will vigilantly oversee using his powers,” Lato elaborated.
target: Et antequam navis ad destinatum pervenerit, Juan Oro viribus suis vigilanter inspexiet, dixerat Lato.

source: As anticipated, Lumian nodded subtly.
target: Ut praedictum, Lumian subridet et annuit.

source: “What powers does Juan Oro wield?”
target: “Quae vires Juan Oro habet?”

source: [1] Adapted from the Marriage of the Sea ceremony of the Venice Doge set to be hanged.
target: [1] Adaptatum ex caerimonia Maris nuptiarum Dogonis Venetiarum ad suspendendum constituta.
